title: Fixed Parallel Arm and Level Carrier Camera Jib
description: One newly authored whole static empty camera jib. Four broad ground pads, two long rails and a full crossmember support an upright stepped column with two full braces and a high two-cheek fork. Two complete parallel arms run from the paired rear axes to two real far axes; the upper arm continues behind the column as a full tail carrying a bored counterweight and fixed grip. All four transverse pins span their complete cheeks and arms. Two full far carrier cheeks connect both forward axes and the cross-seat beneath them, ending in an empty horizontal camera mounting plate. It is not a single grip-boom stand with a spigot, a one-arm hydraulic shop crane with a hook, or a gate boom with a separate catchpost. Entirely new numeric geometry, no imported old asset. Three opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up, actual horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One model and zero scenes. Fixed illustrative art only; no camera, payload, real bearings, rigging, animation, automatic leveling, movement range, balance, load rating, manufacture, operation or equipment-safety claim.
